question: Under the Atal Pension Yojana, the pension returns are given after the subscriber turns ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**60 years old**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Atal Pension Yojana:-**

 
 
• **It is a government-backed pension scheme targeted at unorganized sector workers. **
 
• It was launched in 2015 to provide a defined pension to all eligible subscribers.
 
• The pension amount depends on the age of the subscriber at the time of joining the scheme, the contribution amount, and the tenure of the contribution.
 
• The minimum age of entry is 18 years and the maximum age is 40 years.
 
• **The subscriber has to make regular contributions till the age of 60 years to receive the pension benefits. **
 
• The amount of contribution depends on the age of entry and the pension amount chosen by the subscriber.
